blocks.text: Critically acclaimed singer-songwriter Ashe is unveiling her new single “Stop The Wedding!” alongside a video directed by Silken Weinberg. The track is her debut release with Atlantic Records; listen/share the track HERE and watch/share the video HERE. “Stop The Wedding!” was produced by Noah Conrad (Olivia Rodrigo, Chappell Roan), and written by Ashe alongside Noah and Annika Bennett (ROLE MODEL, Conan Gray). The track channels classic pop drama through its tempo shifts, stacked vocal layers, and string arrangements. The idea came to Ashe at an unlikely moment: on her wedding day last year, when she wed fellow musician John Clark Canada […]...
